title: Canonical derived open restriction and its representative normalization

proof.text: Apply moduleDirectImageOpenPasting_canonical. Its mate equation agrees with directImageOpenRestriction: expand the inverse composite, and identify the equality transport with upperStarCongr along the reversed square equation. Hence the underived comparison is an isomorphism. Its Sectionwise clause gives both bijective open-slice coprojections and the exact sectionArrow formula in OpenCoherenceSectionwise, by unfolding the two helper spellings.

Spell the module preadditive structures as projections of the fixed abelian instances to avoid expanding the module-instance diamond. For a K-injective I apply derivedExchangeUnitQ to the specified upperStar/lowerStar adjunctions and openCoherencePullbackSquare. Open restriction preserves K-injectives by the existing exact extension-by-zero adjunction instance. Rewrite both right-derived units as inverse evaluation isomorphisms. Precompose by the inverse evaluation, and cancel the exact restriction factor with its inverse. This gives precisely the representative normalization equation.

The degreewise image of the underived comparison is an isomorphism, as is its localization. Thus the right-hand side of the representative equation is a composite of isomorphisms. Cancel the exact factor on its left-hand side to obtain invertibility at Q(I). Every derived object is isomorphic to Q(I) for a K-injective I (DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isKInjective); transport invertibility using naturality and NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso. Finally NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app gives invertibility of the natural transformation. Use the normalization structure constructor to package this with the underived isomorphism, section normalization and representative equation.
